title: Material 3 Expressive for Android
description: Material 3 Expressive components that map one to one onto Jetpack Compose material3.
instructions:
Design guidelines for the m3-expressive catalog.

1. Every prop that names a color, type, shape or spacing takes a token name, never a hex value or a raw dimension. Use a `style` from the design system's `material.styles` to bundle tokens.
2. Components reference children by id. Named slots (`topBar`, `content`, `floatingActionButton`) take one id; lists (`children`, `actions`, `items`) take an array of ids.
3. A screen is a flat component list with exactly one `root`. Overlays (`BottomSheet`, `Dialog`, `Menu`) stay closed until an `open` action names them.
4. Interaction is renderer-only: `navigate`, `back`, `open` and `dismiss`. Event actions do not exist.
5. Mark the screen's main action with `primary: true` on one component, and give every icon-only control a `contentDescription`.
6. Use `showIn` and `sizeClass` to adapt a component at 600 dp (medium) and 840 dp (expanded).

verticalAlignment.description: stretch: Column, Row, and Box children fill the row's height, for full-height panes.

Box.description: Stacks children on top of each other.

Grid.description: Lays children out in a grid with a column count or a minimum column width.

columns.description: Fixed column count. Must be a whole number from 1 to 24.

minColumnWidth.description: Minimum column width in dp; columns fill the width. Must be a number from 1 to 1000.

spacing.description: Gap between cells. A name from the design system's spacing scale (default: none, xxs, xs, sm, md, lg, xl, xxl, xxxl).

FlexBox.description: Lays children out in a row that wraps.

gap.description: A name from the design system's spacing scale (default: none, xxs, xs, sm, md, lg, xl, xxl, xxxl).

width.description: A name from the design system's spacing scale (default: none, xxs, xs, sm, md, lg, xl, xxl, xxxl).

height.description: A name from the design system's spacing scale (default: none, xxs, xs, sm, md, lg, xl, xxl, xxxl).

Shape.description: Clips its child to a MaterialShapes polygon.

Text.description: A run of text in a type role.

maxLines.description: Must be a whole number from 1 to 100.

Icon.description: A Material Symbols icon (Rounded, weight 400, grade 0).

size.description: Size in dp. Must be a number from 1 to 512.

Image.description: A bitmap from a file next to the proposal or a data URI.

src.description: Path relative to the proposal, or a data: URI.

aspectRatio.description: Width divided by height. Must be a number from 0.1 to 10.

Carousel.description: A horizontally scrolling collection of visual items, clipped to the carousel's item shape.

variant.description: hero and full-screen have no composable of their own: they size the items of a multi-browse and an uncontained carousel.

itemWidth.description: Item width in dp: the preferred width of multi-browse, the width of uncontained. The other variants size their items themselves. Must be a number from 40 to 1000.

Scaffold.description: The screen frame: bars, floating action button and content.

title.description: The heading. In a search app bar it is the search field's hint, which includes the word Search (such as "Search inbox").

actions.description: The trailing icon buttons. A search app bar has at most two at compact widths, an avatar coming in addition, and up to four from medium widths up (override `actions` in `sizeClass`).

avatar.description: Search size only: a profile picture, drawn as a 30dp circle after the actions. Path relative to the proposal, or a data: URI.

expanded.description: Search size only: the SearchView that opens when the search field is tapped.

badge.description: A badge on the icon's upper trailing corner: true draws a small one, a number or a string of at most 4 characters (such as "99+") draws a large one with that text.

Tabs.description: A row of tabs that switches between sibling views at the same level of hierarchy.

scrollable.description: Lets the tabs scroll when they do not fit.

Tab.description: One tab of a Tabs row. Its content is the screen its action navigates to.

NavigationRail.description: Side navigation for medium and expanded windows.

DockedToolbar.description: A toolbar docked to the bottom of the window, full width, in the Scaffold's bottomBar slot. It replaces the bottom app bar and is never shown with a navigation bar.

SearchBar.description: A search field. Tapping it opens the SearchView named by `expanded`.

placeholder.description: The hint, a short description of what can be searched ("Search mail").

leadingIcon.description: A non-functional icon at the start. Material Symbols name.

navigationIcon.description: A navigational icon button (menu, arrow) that replaces the leading icon.

trailing.description: Trailing icon buttons. At most two, an avatar counting as one.

avatar.description: A profile picture, drawn as a 30dp circle after the trailing icon buttons. Path relative to the proposal, or a data: URI.

contentDescription.description: Accessibility label when it differs from the label.

ProgressIndicator.description: A linear or circular progress indicator; indeterminate when progress is absent.
ProgressIndicator.x-compose: LinearProgressIndicator, CircularProgressIndicator, and the Wavy variants

progress.description: Completed fraction. Must be a number from 0 to 1.

BottomSheet.description: A modal sheet from the bottom edge, with a drag handle. Its content spans the sheet edge to edge, as ModalBottomSheet adds no side padding: put it in a Column with padding.

Dialog.description: A modal dialog. Basic is for alerts, quick selection and confirmation. Full-screen is for tasks with several steps, keyboard input or changes that are not saved at once, and only for compact windows: from medium up, use a basic dialog.
Dialog.x-compose: AlertDialog; full-screen: Dialog (full window) holding a Scaffold with a TopAppBar, composed; no full-screen dialog composable

confirm.description: The confirming text button. Full-screen: in the header, labeled by its outcome (Save, Send, Create), never disabled.

dismiss.description: Basic only: the dismissive text button.

content.description: Full-screen only: the body below the header.

DatePicker.description: A date or date range picker. Modal is a calendar in a dialog, modal-input is keyboard entry in a dialog, docked is a dropdown calendar below the text field named by `anchor`, and full-screen (compact windows) fills the window. Dates are ISO ("2026-11-06") and the picker opens on the month of the selected one.
DatePicker.x-compose: DatePickerDialog holding DatePicker or DateRangePicker; docked: Popup below the text field; full-screen: Dialog (full window) holding a Scaffold, composed

range.description: Picks a range of dates (DateRangePicker) instead of one.

selected.description: The selected date, ISO (YYYY-MM-DD). Not for a range.

start.description: A range's first date, ISO (YYYY-MM-DD). Required for a range.

end.description: A range's last date, ISO, on or after `start`.

anchor.description: The text field a docked picker opens below. Required when docked.

TimePicker.description: A time picker in a dialog: a dial, or keyboard entry (input). The keyboard icon switches between them. Whether the clock is 12 or 24 hours is the device's setting; `is24Hour` only sets it for the preview.

is24Hour.description: Preview only: a 24-hour clock, with no AM/PM selector. The export leaves the clock format to the device, as Material does.

Menu.description: A popup menu anchored to a component.

colors.description: Vibrant is tertiary-based and more prominent: use it sparingly.

items.description: MenuItems, or MenuGroups of MenuItems (not both).

MenuGroup.description: A group of a Menu, set apart from its neighbors by a gap. Single-select items select within their group.

role.description: Action runs and closes the menu. Single is one choice of its group: the selection moves and the menu closes. Multi toggles and the menu stays open.

selected.description: Single and multi only: the initial selection.

SideSheet.description: A modal side sheet on the trailing edge, with a header (title, close icon button) over its content. Optional content beside the main content is a standard side sheet: a screen with pane role supporting.
SideSheet.x-compose: Dialog (full window) holding a scrim and a Surface, composed; no side sheet composable

back.description: Shows a back icon button at the header's leading side and runs this on a tap.

SearchView.description: The focused state of a SearchBar or search app bar: its input field over a list of suggestions or results, in the contained style. Full-screen fills the window; docked opens a dropdown below the bar.
SearchView.x-compose: ExpandedFullScreenContainedSearchBar or ExpandedDockedSearchBarWithGap, sharing the bar's SearchBarState

Tooltip.description: A tooltip anchored to a component. Plain describes an icon-only control; rich adds a subhead and up to two text buttons.

actions.description: Rich only: up to two text buttons, side by side.

Snackbar.description: A brief message at the bottom of the screen, in the Scaffold's snackbar slot above the FAB and the navigation bar.
Snackbar.x-compose: SnackbarHost in Scaffold(snackbarHost), Snackbar via SnackbarHostState.showSnackbar

actionLabel.description: The label of the one action a snackbar may have.

action.description: What a tap on the action label does.

dismiss.description: Shows a close icon that dismisses the snackbar.

x-m3-omissions.why: Material 3 Expressive no longer recommends it; use an expanded navigation rail.
Material 3 Expressive no longer recommends it; use a connected button group.

navigate.description: Opens the screen with this id.

open.description: Opens a BottomSheet, Dialog, Menu, SideSheet, SearchView, Snackbar, Tooltip, DatePicker or TimePicker of the same screen by id.

Action.description: A renderer-side function call. Event actions are not supported.

showIn.description: Size classes the component shows in; all by default.

sizeClass.description: Prop overrides per size class (medium 600 to 839 dp, expanded 840 dp and up).

weight.description: Relative weight inside a Row or Column. Must be a number from 0.01 to 100.

padding.description: Padding around the component. A name from the design system's spacing scale (default: none, xxs, xs, sm, md, lg, xl, xxl, xxxl).

ShapeValue.description: A corner token or a MaterialShapes polygon.
